# systeam_agent_registration_token (Resource)

Mints a one-time token to enroll a private (or geo) agent. The agent trades this token for a permanent key via `healthcheck-agent register`. Write-only and valid for one hour; changing any input mints a new token.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name for the agent that will be created when this token is used.
- `organization_id` (Number) The organization the enrolled agent will belong to.

### Optional

- `mode` (String) Agent mode: 'private' (customer host) or 'geo' (superadmin-only geo probe).

### Read-Only

- `expires_at` (String) RFC3339 expiry (one hour after creation).
- `id` (String) Synthetic identifier ('<organization_id>:<name>').
- `token` (String, Sensitive) The one-time enrollment token. Pass to `healthcheck-agent register -token`.
